name: flower-man
description: Flower Man: flower marketplace and delivery platform (Bergamo pilot).

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.db:check: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml exec -T db psql -U flower_man -d flower_man -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS db_user, current_setting('server_version') AS postgres, postgis_lib_version() AS postgis, current_setting('TimeZone') AS timezone, datlocprovider AS locale_provider, datlocale AS locale FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database();"
